run_preprocess_ef_cli: run the preprocess_ef script to create LMDB files from extxyz trajectory files for S2EF
run_preprocess_ef_with_edges: run preprocess_ef with --get-edges flag to store edge indices in LMDB output
run_preprocess_ef_test_data: run preprocess_ef with --test-data flag to process test data without energy or forces
run_preprocess_ef_ref_energy: run preprocess_ef with --ref-energy flag to subtract reference energies from data objects
run_preprocess_ef_multi_worker: run preprocess_ef with --num-workers to parallelize feature extraction across multiple processes
